settingsHint: Choose a real voice available on this device or your configured speech service.
voiceUnavailable: No compatible voice is available. Replies remain visible as text.
voiceFallback: Your selected voice is unavailable for this language. A compatible device voice is being used.
cloudConsentHint: Send only the current audio turn or short reply to the configured speech service. DukaanSet does not save raw recordings.
autoLanguage: Your app language is the default. Clear speech sets the conversation language; short answers keep it.
deviceRecognition: Device recognition uses the current conversation language. Automatic multilingual recognition needs the configured speech service.
quickHint: One task, a short reply, then review and save.
talkHint: Speak, listen, and answer naturally. Tap the microphone to begin.
textFallback: Audio could not play. You can read the reply and keep typing.
previewText: Hello! I am your DukaanSet assistant. Tell me what your shop needs.
permissionHint: Allow microphone access in your browser. Stop listening or close VoiceOS to release it.
usage: Speech usage in the last 24 hours
costUnavailable: Configure provider rates to estimate cost. Actual billing comes from your provider.
welcome: Hello! How can I help with your shop today?
askStockItems: Which products and quantities should I add to stock?
askProduct: Which product do you mean? Choose a verified match below.
askUnit: Which unit do you mean: pieces, packets or kilograms?
askPrice: What is the selling price for {{product}}?
askPayment: The total is {{total}}. Was it cash, UPI or credit?
askCustomer: Which customer do you mean? Choose the correct record below.
askAmount: How much money was received or spent?
askAmbiguous: Do you want to make a bill or add stock? Are these different products, or the quantity of one product?
askMeaning: Do you want to create a named product or get a product recommendation?
askReview: Please check the highlighted details before continuing.
askUnknown: Tell me the task, for example a bill, stock update or customer payment.
insufficient: Only {{quantity}} {{unit}} of {{product}} is available. Reduce the quantity or receive stock first.
readySale: {{customer}}’s bill is ready: {{total}} total, {{cash}} cash, {{upi}} UPI and {{credit}} credit. Shall I save it?
readyStock: {{count}} stock items are ready. Check the quantities and prices, then say “save” or use Save All Stock.
readyCustomer: The customer {{name}} is ready to add. Shall I save it?
readyProduct: {{name}} is ready to create with no opening stock. Shall I save it?
readyPayment: Record {{amount}} received from {{customer}} by {{method}}? Say “save” after reviewing.
readyExpense: The expense {{name}} for {{amount}} is ready. Shall I save it?
reviewWorkflow: I have prepared this workflow. Open it to check the details and use its confirmation.
confirmedSale: {{number}} for {{customer}} is saved. The total is {{total}} and {{credit}} remains on credit. Stock and the customer account are updated.
confirmedStock: Stock is saved. {{count}} items were updated.
confirmedProduct: {{name}} is saved with no opening stock.
confirmedPayment: The received payment is saved and the customer account is updated.
errorDraft: I could not complete the action. Your draft is still available to review and retry.
errorPending: The server result is uncertain. The saved request is protected; check or retry that same request.
notReady: Please complete the missing details first. Nothing has been saved.
cancelled: The unfinished draft is cancelled. No business records were changed.
stopNotice: Conversation paused. Your draft is still available.
resultIntro: Here is the result from your shop records: {{result}}.
closingResult: For {{date}}, sales are {{sales}} and collections are {{collections}}.
cloudNotConfigured: Cloud speech is not configured. Device speech and typing remain available.
ended: Conversation ended. Your saved records are unchanged.
speaker: You
autoEndHint: Finish speaking naturally. Your turn ends automatically.
askShopScope: I can check customers in your active shop. Do you mean your shop’s customer records? I cannot verify a worldwide customer count.
customerExists: This customer already exists in your shop. Open the record below instead of creating a duplicate.
